column1: # Vietnamese (vi) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); the translation lists the
#                                 language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Status: intentionally incomplete. Missing entries fall back to English. `complete_menus` stays
# false until the catalog covers menus, `tl!` literals, blend modes and preference labels.
# Phase 3.1–3.4: menus through Filter. View / Window / Help and dialogs remain later.
# dialogs remain for later batches.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Vietnamese computing and image-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string
# table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Product and technology
# names (PhotoCraft, ArtCraft, OpenType, RGB, CMYK, Lab, PSD, PNG, JPEG, WebP, OpenEXR, AVIF …)
# stay as they are; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept. Plural rule: one form
# (`plural_none` in i18n/mod.rs).
